name: H. M. Heath
role: Wells, Fargo & Co. express route agent
bio: H. M. Heath was the travelling route agent of Wells, Fargo & Co.'s express, who in December 1884 came to Medora to set up agent Maxwell as agent for two rival express companies. In January 1885 the paper joked about his friendly meeting with DeForce, the rival company's route agent.

moments.label: Set up Maxwell as agent for two express companies

mentions: H. M. Heath, of Wells, Fargo & Co.'s express, was here Tuesday, initiating agent Maxwell into the double-headed act of being agent for two rival express companies.
H. M. Heath, Wells, Fargo's travelling agent, made us another visit Monday. He says that the W., F. are after gore, and by the looks of their express car they are getting it.
